expanse27_dark_star_magazine.name: Amun-Ra torpedo magazine
expanse27_dark_star_magazine.description: Eight torpedoes. Launches two every 10 seconds while an eligible target is available; reloads for 120 seconds after the last pair.
expanse27_dark_star.name: OPAS Dark Star
expanse27_dark_star.description: A salvaged stealth capital: three defensive PDCs, one fixed Amun-Ra railgun, the existing stealth torpedo magazine and guarded boarding. Black-ops salvage is a fan-design adaptation. Fragile compared with dedicated battleships.
expanse27_behemoth_magazine.name: Behemoth surplus torpedo magazine
expanse27_behemoth_magazine.description: Eight existing UNN-profile light torpedoes: two per ten seconds, 120-second reload after the last pair. Base damage 750 each, speed 2125, 30-second fuel; native missile research applies. No planetary or global launch capability.
